method: Compile both full lesson Python fences and run typed schema fixtures against the extracted validator and merge helper. Exercise missing fields, wrong types, bool-as-number, source requirements, and valid/invalid merge candidates. No provider or network calls.

observations.trace: The previous validator accepted string amounts, boolean amounts/turns and omitted category fields. New validation and post-merge revalidation reject these cases while accepting the lesson-shaped fixture.

limitations: Fixtures verify the explicitly modeled field/type contract only; they do not prove extracted facts are true, complete, current or authorized.
Historical token, retention and answer-quality summaries remain unreproducible.
